about_the_game:
This is the story about a guy and a (dragon) girl and their love for concept cafes. A cute, romantic comedy visual novel by new Japanese brand, Cutephoria!

STORY

"The Beginning of Dra-Con Cafe"

As simply explained by Mother Dragon Maru-chan

Fearburn, a world of swords and sorcery. Sitting at the top of the food chain was the commanding presence of dragons. And amongst them were the seven all-powerful dragon kings that ruled over the world.

There was only one being that the seven dragon kings revered above all else... The one they acknowledge as their master and the strongest being in the world... Marmalydia Dot Fearburn, the Mother Dragon. To the seven dragon kings, she is on the same level as god and was worshipped with love and reverence.

"It would have been all fine and good if it stopped there..."

Due to excessive worship, whenever I went out for leisure, it would turn into a country-wide celebration. Even the home I lived in started becoming a sacred pilgrimage site.

"Frankly speaking, it was getting annoying..."

So with all that said, I decided to go on a vacation in another world. And this store I casually entered would soon greatly influence my destiny.

"How could you get here so late, Master!"

"Oh...? (What is with this ill-mannered maid... should I burn her to cinders?)"

"... Come here a bit earlier next time, okay?"

"Hmm... (Her mannerisms have changed...)"

What I entered was a tsundere maid concept cafe. For someone like me who would expect to always be shown a cordial welcome... It was all very refreshing, novel, a first time experience for me!

As I began to get hooked on these concept cafes, I crossed paths with a human male- Shidou Masamune and we hit it off like pals. We became comrades-in-arms as we visited various concept cafes together.

Well, that same comrade I accidentally set on fire with dragon breath though.

Setting aside the specifics here, I used magic to bring Masamune back to life. Then Masamune inherited the cafe that his grandfather once owned, and that was now starting to be troublesome for him. It was around then that I felt like wanting to try running a concept cafe of my own.

These coincidences happening one after another meant that this was simply fate.

There was only one thing to do!

A dragon-themed cafe with all things dragon!

It will be called, the Dra-Con Cafe!

And thus the alternate world-feeling, dragon-filled cafe, the Dra-Con Cafe, is now open!

FEATURES

  • Single route, visual novel

  • Character designs by Kocha

  • Standard save/load, CG gallery functionality

  • Dragon girls and concept cafes

  • Japanese full voice (except for the main character)

  • English and Chinese text language options

content_descriptors.notes: Product contains mild violence, mature and suggestive themes that may not be suitable for all ages.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen and above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3600 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1080p/Full HD support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 500 or AMD Radeon HD6000 and above

short_description: Masamune was just an average guy who enjoyed going to concept cafes when his life is changed forever after crossing paths with the dragon girl, Marmalydia. Join them as they open the doors at Cafe Lumière, a dragon-filled concept cafe!
